items.title: GPT-6 is entering protein design
items.oneliner: OpenAI says GPT-6 can design proteins directly, pushing foundation models from text generation into wet-lab adjacent discovery.

items.title: Bonsai 2.5 shrinks local coding models
items.oneliner: Prism's 27B ternary model fits in 5.9 GB, making private on-device coding agents much more practical.

items.title: PyTorch KL divergence is mathematically broken
items.oneliner: A new paper found PyTorch KL divergence returns wrong values across millions of cases, which can silently corrupt training.

items.title: Check Point servers face active intrusion
items.oneliner: GreyNoise saw 22 organizations hit via Check Point management servers, with 99 attacker IPs and broad sector exposure.

items.title: The CIA suffered another cyber breach
items.oneliner: An unclassified CIA system was breached, reminding every enterprise that segmentation still fails under real attacker pressure.

items.title: Quad9 is leaving France over blocking orders
items.oneliner: Quad9 pulled DNS service from France rather than enforce court-ordered blocks, turning internet policy into infrastructure risk.

items.title: Microsoft declared Code Red after outage
items.oneliner: Reuters says Microsoft's historic outage triggered a Code Red, putting cloud reliability back on every CTO's roadmap.

items.title: Mason turns Postgres replicas columnar
items.oneliner: Mason syncs Postgres into DuckDB-style storage and claims up to 81x faster analytics without touching the primary.

items.title: Brickie brings sandboxes into your cloud
items.oneliner: Brickie lets teams run durable sandboxes in their own AWS or Kubernetes account, which matters for agent security.

items.title: Songe trains local models while idle
items.oneliner: Songe uses idle local compute to personalize models from your corrections, pointing toward private always-learning agents.
